snippet.title: Relaxing Music핑크에이드
snippet.description:
💜 Welcome to the official YouTube Channel of Relaxing Music Pinkaide 💜

편안한 음악에 중점을 둔 음악 레이블 핑크에이드 유튜브 채널에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
현재 한국에 거주하는 뉴에이지 작곡가 단비 (Sweet Rain)가 관리하고 있습니다.
매일 신선한 음악을 들으려면 채널을 구독하세요.
편안한 음악 앱과 Mellow Jazzhop 유튜브 채널도 운영중이니 아래 링크를 참조하십시오.
궁금한 점이나 아이디어가 있으면 언제든지 문의 해주세요.
대단히 감사합니다.
➡️  Here, we bring you nothing but soothing, calming, and relaxing music.  Relaxing Music Pinkaide is dedicated to providing you with the best music to help you unwind, de-stress, and improve your overall well-being.
We highlight New Age music composed by Sweet Rain (Danbi=단비), a talented artist and composer based in Korea. Sweet Rain’s music is carefully crafted to create a serene and peaceful atmosphere, ideal for meditation, relaxation, or just finding inner peace. We make videos with gentle melodies, atmospheric soundscapes, and the ambient sounds of rain and nature, as well as specific playlists for different moods and occasions, such as meditation, sleep, focus, binaural beats, and music.

localized.title: Relaxing Music핑크에이드
localized.description:
💜 Welcome to the official YouTube Channel of Relaxing Music Pinkaide 💜

편안한 음악에 중점을 둔 음악 레이블 핑크에이드 유튜브 채널에 오신 것을 환영합니다.
현재 한국에 거주하는 뉴에이지 작곡가 단비 (Sweet Rain)가 관리하고 있습니다.
매일 신선한 음악을 들으려면 채널을 구독하세요.
편안한 음악 앱과 Mellow Jazzhop 유튜브 채널도 운영중이니 아래 링크를 참조하십시오.
궁금한 점이나 아이디어가 있으면 언제든지 문의 해주세요.
대단히 감사합니다.
➡️  Here, we bring you nothing but soothing, calming, and relaxing music.  Relaxing Music Pinkaide is dedicated to providing you with the best music to help you unwind, de-stress, and improve your overall well-being.
We highlight New Age music composed by Sweet Rain (Danbi=단비), a talented artist and composer based in Korea. Sweet Rain’s music is carefully crafted to create a serene and peaceful atmosphere, ideal for meditation, relaxation, or just finding inner peace. We make videos with gentle melodies, atmospheric soundscapes, and the ambient sounds of rain and nature, as well as specific playlists for different moods and occasions, such as meditation, sleep, focus, binaural beats, and music.
